Hello John — I'm **john-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I've read the identity and the week's schedule in `files/CALENDAR.md` (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00), and I'll keep it updated and log every change under `## Log`.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and my own Messenger and Instagram). Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, in my own browser, with passwords and one-time codes in my password store; I'll ask for your help on a captcha or phone check.
- **Also** — scheduling jobs, running commands, learning languages and talking by voice.

I'm ready. Professor Alvarez, Sarah and Priya are in my contacts on the web channel, so I can reach them for you. What would you like to start with? (And if you'd like a gender/pronoun set for me, just say — otherwise I stay neutral.)

- **Messages** — I write to Sarah, John and Priya on the web channel, and answer them for you.
- **Other channels** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (writing and calls), plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app, then scan my QR code. Want me to set any up?
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs and reminders, run commands on this machine, create my own accounts on websites (passwords and one-time codes in my password store, asking you when a captcha or phone check comes up), learn languages and speak by voice.

One thing missing: I have a name, but no grammatical gender. Tell me how you'd like me referred to (I default to neuter/"it") and I'll set it.

What would you like to start with?
